name: brysons-claude-setup
description: Bryson's Claude Setup: Claude Code plugins by Bryson Smith

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Bryson's everyday Claude Code setup: installs all five mods below in one go

plugins.name: pinboard
plugins.description: Sidebar where Claude keeps its todos, the questions it needs you to answer, links and key findings. From sirkitree/pinboard

plugins.name: usage-meters
plugins.description: One line above the prompt: 5-hour limit, weekly limit and context window as colored meters with reset times

plugins.name: session-watch
plugins.description: One line above the prompt with every other background Claude session and whether it is working, done or needs you

plugins.name: cc-image-view
plugins.description: Thumbnails of pasted images above the prompt (needs a terminal with kitty graphics, such as WezTerm). Adapted from jarrodwatts/claude-image-view

plugins.name: idle-opacity
plugins.description: WezTerm window goes solid when Claude stops so the answer is easy to read, see-through while it works (needs terminal/wezterm.lua)
